<thought>The mass spectrum shows a monoisotopic m/z of ~100.052 Da, which corresponds to the formula C₅H₈O₂ (exact mass 100.0524 Da). A simple structure fitting this formula and the unsaturation count (2 DBE) is methyl acrylate, SMILES C=CC(=O)OC. The SMILES is valid.</thought>
<final_answer>C=CC(=O)OC</final_answer>
